snippet.title: Out Fishing - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Out Fishing, a first-person horror fishing game developed by Mun Mun Games. Players will fish, sell, upgrade gear, and build a camp in this first-person horror fishing game. Explore a haunted forest and uncover clues about a forgotten disappearance near the lake, but return before nightfall, as danger lurks beneath the water. Out Fishing is coming soon to PC (Steam).
